channel.title: Inkframe Changelog
channel.description: Release notes for Inkframe — the AI-assisted design review tool. Track new features, improvements, fixes, and breaking changes.

item.title: [v2.5.0] AI Comment Summarization
item.description: Inkframe now groups design feedback threads and surfaces a one-line AI summary per section, cutting review time by ~40% in beta.

item.title: [v2.4.2] Figma Variables sync fix
item.description: Variable tokens with slash-separated names were stripped on export. Resolved. No action required from users.

item.title: [v2.4.1] Small things — week of Mar 7
item.description: Keyboard shortcut for frame export, share links that copy on click, and comment avatars showing initials as fallback.

item.title: [v2.4.0] Breaking: Webhook payload shape changed
item.description: The spec.created webhook event now wraps the payload under a data key. Update your handler before Mar 14 to avoid disruption.

item.title: [v2.3.3] Security: Token scope fix
item.description: A read-scoped API token could enumerate project names under certain conditions. Fixed and all affected tokens invalidated. Regenerate yours.

item.title: [v2.3.2] Annotation panel performance
item.description: Annotation panel now renders 3x faster on specs with 200+ components. Virtualized list replaces full DOM render.

item.title: [v2.3.0] Team Workspaces launch
item.description: Shared workspaces with role-based access. Invite teammates by email or SSO. Free tier: 1 workspace, 3 members.

item.title: [v2.2.1] Deprecation notice: v1 Export API
item.description: The /v1/export endpoint will be removed on Apr 1, 2026. Migrate to /v2/specs. Docs updated with migration guide.

item.title: [v2.2.0] Dark mode for shared specs
item.description: Recipients of shared spec links can now toggle dark mode. Preference saved to localStorage — no account required.

item.title: [v2.1.4] Small things — week of Jan 2
item.description: Better Figma OAuth error messages, clickable links in PDF exports, and a 12KB bundle size reduction.
